en.content:
Select the Seedance 2.0 video creation Skill in Lovart, and generate a complete promotional video for your app in one go by assembling AI assets such as a female model, app screenshots, and BGM.

Within Lovart’s large canvas, you can create different versions in the same project: iPhone/iPad-sized assets for the App Store, English-language versions in the same size, still images for social media, and even a usage-scene commercial with BGM.

Depending on your goal, switch between Lovart’s Skills (one-shot video, storyboard, ad creative, etc.) to quickly generate multiple variations, then fine-tune them and use them to validate ideas.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
📝 If you’re launching an app, I recommend making promotional assets with Lovart!

For the App Store, I was able to create everything entirely within Lovart’s large canvas: iPhone and iPad-sized assets, English versions in the same sizes, still images for social media, and even a commercial showing app usage scenes with an AI model and BGM.

No specialized expertise is needed, and there are various “Skills” available:
・Seedance 2.0 video creation
・One-shot video
・Storyboard
・Ad creative
・Logo design
Just set the Skill that best matches the creative you want to make!
